messages:
Alicia M: Drafting a pocket brief for the enterprise launch sprint — focus: security controls, SLA tiers, and deployment modes. Need a tight 1‑pager + a 3‑bullet benchmark narrative for the webinar tomorrow. Can folks skim and call out must-haves? :eyes:
Ben C: I can draft the content. suggest structure: 1) Problem + risks, 2) Our solution (hosted/dedicated/private), 3) SLAs & compliance callouts, 4) Bench highlights, 5) Call-to-action for AE handoff. Keep it single column punchy.
Priya S: Need a one-line pain point for FinServ and one for Healthcare that sales can use in emails. Also include routing rules for inbound — AEs should get enterprise leads within 15m.
Marco L: For bench bullets, call out median tail latency and cost per 1M tokens at 99th percentile under burst. Also mention quantization options + VPC support.
Sam R: Field request — include a detachable ‘talking points’ box for AEs with quick objection responses (security, data residency, cost).
deploy-bot: New doc created: https://intranet.redwood/sprints/enterprise-pocket-brief-draft (editable)
Ben C: Draft outline attached in thread (paste below) — would like product to verify accuracy before I finalize copy.
Ben C: ```
Pocket brief outline:
- One-line opener (value + risk reduction)
- Deploy modes (hosted / dedicated / private) — 1 sentence each
- SLA tiers (bronze/silver/gold) — what each guarantees
- Security & compliance bullets (KMS, audit logs, VPC)
- Benchmark callouts (latency, throughput, cost delta)
- Field-ready CTA (trial + AE intake link)
```
Marco L: Accuracy notes — wording suggestions:
- Hosted = fastest time-to-value; Dedicated = predictable throughput + reserved GPUs; Private = customer-managed control plane + KMS/HSM.
- SLA example: Gold = 99.95% uptime, <100ms median tail under steady load (config dependent).
- Bench caveat: include dataset + request shape used for numbers.
Priya S: For inbound routing, propose rule snippet — pls verify: 
```
if lead.industry in ["finance","healthcare"] and lead.MQL_score >= 75:
  route -> enterprise-AE-queue (notify via slack @AE-team)
elif lead.MQL_score >= 90 and account_size > 1000:
  route -> enterprise-rapid (15m SLA)
else:
  route -> inbound-nurture
```
Alicia M: Love it. Ben — can you write the two 1-line pain messages? Priya — can you confirm the routing snippet is realistic for platform handoff? Sam — I'll add the talking points box.
Ben C: Two options for opener lines: 
- FinServ: "Reduce model serving risk — predictable SLAs, private deployments, and audit-ready key management for regulated workloads."
- Healthcare: "Secure, auditable inference with VPC + HSM integrations — keep PHI in your control while scaling."
Marco L: Good. Add a note: "Auto-fallback to compatible model variants to preserve availability during capacity spikes."
Priya S: Routing snippet is fine — ops needs the consumer webhook details, but logic is sound. I'll add the AE-runbook steps and a template email for the AE to use.
Alicia M: Final asks: Ben — finish copy + bench bullets (include test harness link). Marco — confirm numbers and one-line SLA commitments. Priya — AE runbook + email template. I'll assemble final 1-pager and export PDF for webinar handout. Target: finalize by EOD. :rocket:
